يستقضون (form X)
# يَسْتَقْضُونَ (yastaqḍūna) /jas.taq.dˤuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَقْضَى (istaqḍā)
# يُسْتَقْضَوْنَ (yustaqḍawna) /jus.taq.dˤaw.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَقْضَى (istaqḍā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
